arguments.command:
cd /workspace && LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/native PYTHONPATH=/workspace/vendor:/workspace/submission python3 -c "
import json, subprocess, sys, time, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from gen2 import gen_case
rng = random.Random(4242)
cases=[]
tot=0
while len(cases)<8 and tot<1024:
    J = min(512, 1024-tot)
    c = gen_case(rng, J, 256, 32, 16, span=1000000)
    cases.append(c); tot += len(c['windows'])
req={'version':3,'cases':cases}
raw=json.dumps(req).encode()
print('bytes in', len(raw), 'windows', tot)
t0=time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=raw,capture_output=True,env={'PATH':'/usr/bin:/bin','LD_LIBRARY_PATH':'/workspace/native','PYTHONPATH':'/workspace/vendor'})
el=time.time()-t0
print('exit',p.returncode,'time %.2f'%el,'stdout bytes',len(p.stdout),'stderr bytes',len(p.stderr))
print('stderr:', p.stderr[:300])
r=json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
print('results',len(r['results']))
for c,res in zip(cases, r['results']):
    print('  J=%d ratio=%s served=%d arcs=%d' % (len(c['windows']), res['ratio'], sum(1 for a in res['assignment'] if a>=0), len(res['flow'])))
"
